title: List Of Various Centre Institutions And Bureaus
definition: A comprehensive compilation of autonomous, statutory, and departmental research centers, institutions, and bureaus under the Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India, responsible for policy implementation, R&D, and techno-socio-economic development.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Prelims (matching agencies to ministries, autonomous vs. statutory status) and Mains GS-3 (Science & Tech policy, indigenous R&D capabilities, institutional bottlenecks).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of List Of Various Centre Institutions And Bureaus.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of the Department of Science & Technology (DST), Department of Biotechnology (DBT), and Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR).
